source_changes: Task-scoped ContextVar replaces thread-local drain guard so concurrent requests enqueue while an insert awaits; recursive logs in drain task and child tasks remain suppressed. set/reset tokens restore guard on success, failure, cancellation.

Installed-handler resume probe uses fixed allowlist phase/outcome, monotonic elapsed, opaque digest of middleware request ID, WARNING level to pass run.py default log floor, and omits ambient identity/route from app_log row. Every explicit resume-preparation await and both implicit async context awaits instrumented before headers; response handoff marked separately.
Outer terminal failure/cancellation uses fixed prepare phase, avoiding false attribution to a completed last await.
